schema.title: Real-content CSR subject disposition listing extraction schema
schema.description: Extract listing metadata and every subject disposition row from a clinical study report appendix listing. One row per subject under a repeated two-line column header; blank cells mean not applicable.

cro_study_number.description: CRO study number from the page header, e.g. '7694-105'.

sponsor_protocol_number.description: Sponsor protocol number from the page header, e.g. 'SM 08-01'.

listing_number.description: Listing number from the title line, e.g. '16.2.1-1'.

study_population.description: Population named on the 'Study Population:' line.

footnote.description: Superscript-a footnote text at the bottom of each page.

dispositions.description: Every subject row in document order.

study_day.description: Study Day column (footnote a: relative to Day 1).

reason_if_withdrawn.description: Withdrawal reason category; also printed for some Completed subjects (e.g. 'Other'). Null when blank.

specify.description: Free-text specification of the reason; null when blank.

investigator_comments.description: Investigator Comments column; null when blank.

source_page.description: Page number as printed on the page of the row. This document's printed page numbering is offset from the PDF page index; report the number printed on the page, not the PDF page position.

value.footnote: Study Day is relative to the date of first study product administration (Day 1).
